protocol.rankingObjective: search loss + 0.2 * candidate bytes / source bytes; lower is better
protocol.initialization: Each run independently measures original and all four uniform quality vectors before other proposals.
protocol.surrogate: Ridge fitted only to observations from the current method and seed; predictions select the next physical measurement.
protocol.cache: No shared observation or score cache. Every method pays for fresh encoding, validation, file reload and rendering.
protocol.heldout: Benchmark comparisons use search-view scores. Final extra-view checks are exercised by project export, not used for benchmark ranking.
protocol.uniformStop: Uniform quality has exactly original plus four levels. It stops after five observations with an unused allowance; no duplicate work is invented.
protocol.selectionRule: Sources, seeds, budgets, objective and limit were fixed before running. All runs, failures and unfilled budgets are preserved.
